provenance.paper: L. London and E. Fauchon-Jones, arXiv:1708.00404
provenance.recipe: fresh HM assembly using the published London equations and explicit positive-m projection
provenance.eq14_carrier_contract: HM QNM values define the outer frequency map; Eq. (14) uses the D carrier's absolute fRD_D and fdamp_D, with HM ratios R=f22_HM/flm_HM and T=fdlm_HM/fd22_HM, and C1 completion at 0.5*fRD_D.
provenance.d_carrier_qnm_source: evaluate_d_qnm_220(final_spin), scaled by total_mass/final_mass; remnant mass and spin remain the opaque IMRPhenomD outputs.
provenance.note: Regenerated after applying the explicit per-case D-carrier QNM contract; the reported residuals are raw diagnostic measurements and do not select coefficients or claim a strict parity gate.
provenance.public_target: existing diagnose_hm_qnm_leaver_clean.py public HM callable and polarizations
provenance.clean_room_scope: No LAL/PyCBC/TEOB implementation or author implementation was copied; LAL is used only as the public comparison target through the existing helper.
provenance.diagnostic_scope: waveform impact only; no production coefficient change and no strict gate claim
provenance.uncertainty: N=61 is a metadata hypothesis inferred from published coefficient intervals, not a proven historical grid or production full-precision source.
